He randomly attacked [[Ash's Pikachu]], thus initiating a battle between the two parties. Ash tried to catch him but was not successful, since Sewaddle ran away. He later reappeared and knocked Ash to the ground when the trio met [[Burgh]], the [[Castelia City]] [[Gym Leader]], who revealed that he was accompanying Sewaddle through the forest, even though he was not his Pokémon. When Ash and his friends tried to say hello to Sewaddle by using the two sensory knobs on the top of his head, he tackled Ash, while he kindly said hello to {{an|Iris}}, Pikachu, {{TP|Iris|Axew}}, and Burgh. They followed Sewaddle for the rest of the day, observing his eating and sleeping habits. After Ash protected him from a double {{m|Air Slash}} attack, Sewaddle started to warm up to him, offering him some fruit and even sleeping with him and Pikachu in his sleeping bag. [[File:Ash Sewaddle ruined hood.png|thumb|250px|Sewaddle with his "clothes" ruined]] The next day, due to his leaf's healing properties, Sewaddle was kidnapped by a {{p|Patrat}} who wanted to help its sick friend but managed to swing away with his {{m|String Shot}}. However, he got stuck on a {{p|Deerling}}'s neck, who became agitated and messed up his leaf hood. As Ash and his friends ran towards him, Sewaddle tried to swing himself towards them but was caught by a sudden gust of wind and fell off a cliff. Ash dived in to save him, and Burgh called his {{p|Leavanny}} out in time to use String Shot and catch them both. Later, Sewaddle received brand new "clothes" from Leavanny and happily accepted Ash's proposal to join his team, but his {{i|Poké Ball}} became sealed until Ash transferred {{AP|one of his Pokémon|Pidove}} to [[Professor Juniper]], as he already had a full [[party]] of six Pokémon at the time. [[File:Ash Leavanny Swarm.png|thumb|left|250px|{{a|Swarm}} activated]] In ''[[BW019|A Connoisseur's Revenge!]]'', Ash had Sewaddle examined by a C-Class [[Pokémon Connoisseur|Pokémon Connaisseuse]] by the name of [[Burgundy]] so he would know how compatible he was with him. She confirmed that his [[Ability]] was {{a|Swarm}}, which she thought was a bad thing, as she believed Ash would be better off with a Sewaddle with {{a|Chlorophyll}}, but did nothing to support her claim. When she said he should replace Sewaddle, he fired a String Shot at her in anger. Sewaddle was chosen as Ash's second Pokémon in his [[Castelia Gym]] battle in ''[[BW023|Battling For The Love of Bug-types!]]''. First, Sewaddle went up against Burgh's {{p|Dwebble}}, who had already managed to defeat his {{AP|Tepig}}. Despite initially struggling to overcome Dwebble's {{m|Protect}} and powerful moves, Sewaddle managed to dodge or stop the incoming attacks with his String Shot and knocked the Rock Inn Pokémon out of its shell, allowing him to exploit this opening and defeat it. Next, he fought against Burgh's {{p|Whirlipede}}, whose {{m|Steamroller}} proved to be very helpful, cutting through his String Shot with ease and dealing massive supereffective damage. After enduring a {{m|Solar Beam}}, Sewaddle [[Evolution|evolved]] into Swadloon and proceeded to finish off the Curlipede Pokémon with his newfound power. Then, Burgh sent out his last Pokémon, Leavanny. This match-up was quick, as Leavanny was shown to be much more powerful than its pre-evolved form, defeating him with a succession of strong moves, such as {{m|Leaf Storm}} and {{m|Hyper Beam}}. [[File:Ash Leavanny leaf hood.png|thumb|250px|Leavanny's leaf hoods]] In ''[[BW074|Battling the Leaf Thieves!]]'', Swadloon evolved into Leavanny during a training battle against [[Iris's Emolga]]. The battle was cut short, as his innate caring nature came into force right away. Leavanny sewed various leaf hoods for the smaller Pokémon of the group, including a special leaf mask for Axew, and gave new clothes to three wild Sewaddle who were wearing withered leaves. During a nap, a group of {{p|Durant}} came across the gang and took the leaf clothing for food, as well as Axew, who was still wearing his outfit. Once awakened, they immediately noticed his absence and went looking for him, eventually coming across the entrance of the cave where the Durant made their nest. As they ventured down the path, Leavanny cleverly attached its thread to the walls so they could find their way back. After finding nothing, {{an|Cilan}} suggested that Leavanny wrap Ash and {{AP|Scraggy}} with leaves so they could act as bait for the Durant, which proved to be successful and led them to the leaf hoard. After retrieving Axew, the group made its way out of the cave. [[File:Ash and Leavanny.png|thumb|left|250px|Leavanny and Ash]] In ''[[BW083|Rocking the Virbank Gym! Part 1]]'', Leavanny was chosen as Ash's third Pokémon in his [[Virbank Gym]] battle, going up against [[Roxie]]'s {{p|Koffing}}, who had already defeated {{AP|Boldore}} and {{AP|Unfezant}}. Despite being at a type disadvantage, Leavanny managed to defeat Koffing with a String Shot-{{m|Energy Ball}} combo after its {{stat|Special Defense}} had been lowered. Then, Leavanny fought against her {{p|Scolipede}}. Due to its typing and bulk, it easily resisted the attacks thrown in its direction and managed to leave Leavanny {{status|poison|badly poisoned}}, which led to his defeat in [[BW084|the next episode]]. In ''[[BW090|Jostling for the Junior Cup!]]'', Leavanny was used in the first round of the [[Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup]] against [[Marris]]'s {{p|Karrablast}}. He was able to quickly knock Karrablast out, thus leading Ash to the second round. [[File:Ash Leavanny dodging.png|thumb|250px|Leavanny dodging attacks with gracefulness]] In ''[[BW106|Strong Strategy Steals the Show!]]'', Ash used Leavanny as his third Pokémon in his battle against [[Stephan]] during the [[Vertress Conference]], sending him out against [[Stephan's Sawk]]. Initially, Leavanny was able to swiftly and gracefully dodge Sawk's attacks, as well as deal big damage with his own moves, but the battle started to lean to Stephan's side after Sawk scored a {{m|Low Sweep}}, allowing him to strike Leavanny with a barrage of {{m|Close Combat}}s. This, however, activated Leavanny's Swarm Ability, giving him a big boost on his {{type|Bug}} moves, allowing him to bind Sawk in his threads even after the Karate Pokémon had used two {{m|Bulk Up}}s. After a hard-fought battle, Leavanny was finally brought down by a clean {{m|Karate Chop}} to the head. =====Decolore Islands===== In ''[[BW123|Farewell, Unova! Setting Sail for New Adventures!]]'', Professor Juniper sent Leavanny to [[Professor Oak's Laboratory]] before Ash left for [[Kanto]], touring through the [[Decolore Islands]]. Ash brought Leavanny back to his active party once, in ''[[BW130|Butterfree and Me!]]'', so he could help Ash evolve a wild {{p|Caterpie}} into a {{p|Butterfree}}. Leavanny reunited with Ash and the entire Unova team at Oak's lab in ''[[BW142|The Dream Continues!]]''. He joined in with them to launch a group attack on {{TRT}}, using Energy Ball to send them blasting off for the final time in ''[[Pokémon the Series: Black & White]]''. Later, Leavanny posed in a group photo with the rest of Ash's Pokémon. Then, he was left at the lab when Ash set off for the [[Kalos]] region. ===={{aniseries|JN}}==== [[File:Ash Unova Pokémon JN132.png|thumb|250px|left|Leavanny encouraging Pikachu in a vision]] Leavanny, along with the rest of Ash's Pokémon at the lab, reunited with Ash in ''[[JN114|Friends, Rivals, Lend Me Your Spirit!]]''. During the visit, he was seen relaxing with {{AP|Noctowl}} and {{AP|Gliscor}} and later watched the battle between Ash and [[Paul]]. Before Ash left, he posed with the rest of Ash's Pokémon in a group photo with him. From ''[[JN118|Battling as Hard as Stone!]]'' onwards, Leavanny watched Ash's [[Masters Eight Tournament]] matches against {{an|Steven Stone|Steven}} and {{an|Cynthia}}. In ''[[JN132|Partners in Time!]]'', Leavanny appeared as a vision to Pikachu during his battle against [[Leon's Charizard]]. In ''[[JN135|Heroes Unite!]]'', Leavanny, along with the rest of the Pokémon at the lab, welcomed Ash back to Pallet Town after his victory over Leon. In ''[[JN138|A Fated Face-Off!]]'', Leavanny was shown to have rejoined Ash's team. During the episode, he met {{an|Misty}} and later watched as she and Ash battled over a wild {{TP|Misty|Clauncher}}. {{-}} ===Personality and characteristics=== [[File:Ash Swadloon sewing.png|thumb|250px|Swadloon sewing]] As a Sewaddle, Leavanny was childish, often doing things without warning when Ash first met him, such as attacking {{AP|Pikachu}} for no reason other than wanting to battle. He was stubborn, and wouldn't admit his feelings for Ash right away, but after he had been saved a few times, he became more comfortable with Ash and snuggled up to him. Since then, he had been very caring towards his Trainer, even to go so far as to wrap [[Burgundy]]'s head in a String Shot web merely one episode later when she suggested Ash get rid of him. [[File:Ash Leavanny caring nature.png|thumb|left|250px|Leavanny's caring nature]] Leavanny, as both a Sewaddle and Swadloon, was also competitive since his debut and has a strong passion for battling. He always tried his hardest, allowing him to defeat opponents even when the odds were stacked up against him, such as against [[Burgh]]'s {{p|Dwebble}} and {{p|Whirlipede}}, as well as [[Roxie]]'s {{p|Koffing}}. Since he evolved, Swadloon became a bit more mature and recluded, although he still got a bit childish when he believed {{AP|Oshawott}}, {{AP|Tepig}}, and {{AP|Scraggy}} took his food in ''[[BW025|Emolga and the New Volt Switch!]]''. Swadloon also has some sewing skills, as seen in ''[[BW038|Movie Time! Zorua in "The Legend of the Pokémon Knight"!]]'', where he helped make costumes for [[Luke]]'s movie with [[Luke#Leavanny|his Leavanny]]. After evolving into Leavanny, he adopted a more caring nature and acted like a parent to the other Pokémon. This was shown in ''[[JN138|A Fated Face-Off!]]'', when Leavanny spent the entire episode looking after {{AP|Rowlet}}, soothing him to sleep, and consoling {{TP|Misty|Psyduck}} after its hug offer was ignored by Pikachu. He also became very independent, prancing off on his own to find leaves to use for clothes and taking a lot of pride in his work. He is also able to make good use of his newly acquired skills, cleverly lining the {{p|Durant}}'s maze with thread to mark the way out without being commanded to by his Trainer. As shown in ''[[BW083|Rocking the Virbank Gym! (Part 1)]]'' and ''[[BW106|Strong Strategy Steals the Show!]]'', he has also been able to use these new skills in battle to powerful effect. {{-}} ===Appearance=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{bug color}}; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #{{bug color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{grass color light}}; {{roundytl|5px}}" | As a {{pcolor|Sewaddle|000}} ! style="background:#{{grass color light}}; {{roundytr|5px}}" | As a {{pcolor|Swadloon|000}} |- style="background:#fff" | [[File:Ash Sewaddle.png|250px]] | [[File:Ash Swadloon.png|250px]] |} ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|Bug|Grass|Ash {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 6}}|0=Sewaddle Bug Bite|1=Swadloon Energy Ball|2=Swadloon Tackle|3=Sewaddle String Shot|4=Sewaddle Tackle|5=Sewaddle Razor Leaf}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 6}}|0=Bug Bite

==Trivia== [[File:Sealed Poké Ball anime.png|thumb|200px|Sewaddle's sealed Poké Ball after being caught]] * Leavanny is {{Ash}}'s only {{type|Grass}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that is not a [[first partner Pokémon]]. * Leavanny is the first Pokémon Ash has owned to have evolved via [[friendship]] while under his ownership. * Leavanny is Ash's first {{type|Bug}} Pokémon since his {{AP|Heracross}}, which was {{pkmn2|caught}} in ''[[EP119|A Sappy Ending]]'', 556 episodes earlier. * Sewaddle's capture marked the first time in {{aniseries|PTS}} that Ash had caught a Pokémon while already having a full [[party]] of six Pokémon since he caught his {{AP|Krabby}} in ''[[EP013|Mystery at the Lighthouse]]'', 662 episodes earlier. ** Furthermore, this was also the first time that Ash has had to rotate his seventh Pokémon into his main team. * Leavanny, upon evolving from Sewaddle to Swadloon, is the first of Ash's Pokémon to evolve during a Gym battle. * As a Sewaddle, Leavanny was the first Pokémon in the animated series to have its [[Ability]] confirmed without using it. * Leavanny, as a Sewaddle, is the only Pokémon in {{aniseries|PTS}} to have used the move {{m|Bug Bite}}. * Swadloon's Evolution into Leavanny was first revealed in the Japanese ending [[Seven-colored Arch]]. ==References== ==Related articles== * {{Animespeciesevo2|Sewaddle|Swadloon|Leavanny}}
